title: ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time agentic computation can improve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through planning, tool use, iterative perception, and reflection, but indiscriminate computation may duplicate resolved work, introduce noisy evidence, and perturb correct predictions. We propose that such computation should be residual: allocate additional computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and, after a localized failure, recompute only the affected states. We instantiate this formulation in ReTAC, a training-free multiagent framework for video spatial reasoning. ReTAC organizes supplementary computation around unresolved requirements. It plans ordered steps to acquire missing spatial evidence and combines the observations with compatible native evidence for reasoning. translated_title: ReTAC：用于视频空间推理的残差式测试时智能体计算
translated_abstract: 测试时智能体计算可以通过规划、工具使用、迭代感知和反思来提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的能力，但无差别的计算可能会重复已完成的工作、引入噪声证据，并干扰原本正确的预测。我们提出此类计算应当是残差式的：仅针对基础模型未能解决的需求分配额外的计算，并且在局部失败发生后，只重新计算受影响的状态。我们在ReTAC中实现了这一构想，这是一个用于视频空间推理的免训练多智能体框架。ReTAC围绕未解决的需求来组织补充计算：它规划有序的步骤以获取缺失的空间证据，并将观察结果与兼容的原生证据相结合进行推理。此外，它采用与阶段对齐的验证方式，将失败定位到规划、感知或推理环节。基于依赖关系的恢复机制则只重新计算受影响的状态。
tldr: 提出ReTAC——一个免训练的多智能体框架，通过残差式测试时计算（仅对基础模型未解决的需求追加计算、失败后仅重算受影响状态）来提升视频空间推理能力。
en_tdlr: ReTAC is a training-free multiagent framework that improves video spatial reasoning through residual test-time computation, allocating extra computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and recomputing only affected states after localized failures.
